# DeskUtils 0.2.0
DeskUtils 0.2.0 makes every feature free and improves screenshot editing, Quick Access, display dimming, and Color Picker.
## Every feature is now free
- All features are included without a license key, activation, or a Pro purchase. This includes Quick Ring customization, Capture Text (OCR), Scrolling Capture, Capture Subject, Capture Smart Element, External Display Only, and persistent External Display Dimming. - Clipboard history capacity can be configured up to 500 items. Existing preferences and saved data are preserved. - You can support development through the optional **Support on Ko-fi** action in the menu bar and About settings. Support does not unlock extra features.
## Improvements and fixes
- **Annotate text** — fixed a rendering state issue that could intermittently flip text upside down, including when text was drawn alongside counters or watermarks. - **Live annotation preview** — Blur and Spotlight regions now appear while dragging, before releasing the mouse. Highlight shows an outline around the brush footprint so the affected area stays visible on similar-colored backgrounds. Large new blur regions use a lightweight preview while dragging. Interaction outlines are excluded from copied and saved images. - **Quick Access** — improved button responsiveness, especially Close and Edit. Completed clicks are preserved when the pointer leaves the card, and asynchronous saving no longer loses its interaction state. Fixed clipped card shadows. - **External Display Dimming** — reduced repeated work while dragging the brightness slider and combined brightness updates. The final brightness is applied and saved when dragging finishes or the menu closes. - **Color Picker** — separated HUD movement from color sampling for more responsive cursor tracking. Fixed clipped rounded edges on the Liquid Glass HUD and improved cleanup when canceling or starting another picking session.
## Notes
- Build 17. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later. Liquid Glass uses fallback surfaces on earlier supported versions. - Existing macOS permissions are still required for features that capture the screen or control other applications. - No license activation is required after upgrading from either Free or Pro.

# DeskUtils 0.1.12
DeskUtils 0.1.12 brings Liquid Glass to screenshot editing and capture controls, makes Screenshot History smoother with large collections, and fixes editor focus when opening images from Quick Access or History.
## Improvements
- **Full Annotate** — refreshed toolbars, contextual controls, canvas background controls, and action buttons with Liquid Glass. Toolbar spacing is more consistent, with rounded controls and button press feedback. - **Quick Annotate** — updated floating toolbars and controls to match Full Annotate, including rounded panels and button press feedback. - **Screenshot History** — added Liquid Glass to the HUD background, search, time filters, selection actions, and Restore buttons in both Compact and Expanded modes. Improved scrolling, selection, and switching between modes with large screenshot collections, with more efficient thumbnail loading. - **Window Switcher** — refined the glass panel edge and close button, with button press feedback. - **Scrolling Capture** — updated the HUD and action buttons with Liquid Glass, with softer panel edges and shadows.
## Fixes
- Fixed Full Annotate opening without becoming fully active when Edit is selected in Quick Access or Screenshot History. The editor now comes to the front with active window controls immediately. - Fixed the Full Annotate traffic light buttons not staying centered with the toolbar after window updates or resizing. - Fixed editor toolbar actions being routed while a sheet, such as Save As, is open. - Improved toolbar click handling so dragging between buttons cancels the original click and releasing a button runs its action only once.
## Notes
- Liquid Glass is used on macOS 26 and later, with fallback surfaces on macOS 15.2 and when Reduce Transparency is enabled. Button animations respect Reduce Motion. - Screenshot History keeps its Solid background option. Quick Access retains its existing appearance. - Build 16. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later.

# DeskUtils 0.1.11
DeskUtils 0.1.11 makes window switching smoother, adds quick tool toggles during setup, and restores dragging for pinned screenshots and Clipboard on macOS 27.
## Improvements
- **Window Switcher** — cached previews appear immediately while updated snapshots load in the background. The selected window is refreshed first, with fewer unnecessary background captures. - **Onboarding** — enable or disable Color Picker, Clean Keyboard, Prevent Sleep, External Display Only, External Display Dimming, and Window Switcher directly during setup. - **Quick Ring** — added staggered icon entrance animations, smoother selection transitions, and clearer highlighting for the selected tool. Animations respect the system Reduce Motion setting. - **About** — release notes now open the [DeskUtils changelog](https://deskutils.app/changelog/), and the feedback action opens the [feedback and bug report page](https://deskutils.app/feedback/).
## Fixes
- Fixed pinned screenshots not moving when dragged on macOS 27. Locked screenshots remain fixed in place. - Fixed the Clipboard panel not moving when dragged from an empty area on macOS 27. - Fixed missing Dock Preview thumbnails when multiple preview requests occur at the same time. - Further improved onboarding window sizing on macOS 27 to prevent the setup window from stretching during initial layout.
## Notes
- Window Switcher is now enabled by default when no preference has been saved. Existing on/off preferences are preserved. - Window Switcher requires Accessibility permission. Screen Recording permission is optional and enables window previews. - Build 15. - Requires macOS 15.2 or later.
